definitions.explanation: The darkest color, the absence of light.
Slang for being guilty or culpable.

notes:
{黒|くろ} means black (color) or guilty (slang).

COLOR MEANING:
- {黒|くろ}い: black (i-adjective form)
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}→真っ黒：07614_makkuro⟧: pitch black, jet black
- ⟦{黒髪|くろかみ}→黒髪：20251_kurokami⟧: black hair

SLANG MEANING:
- {黒|くろ}: guilty
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧: innocent
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{黒|くろ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: innocent or guilty

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{黒字|くろじ}→黒字：04715_kuroji⟧: in the black (profit) vs. ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧ (deficit)
- ⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧: blackboard
- ⟦{腹黒|はらぐろ}い→腹黒い：07740_haraguroi⟧: scheming, having a black heart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {黒|くろ}: black
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧: white
